description: Dark Mode and UI/UX Improvements - fix hardcoded colors, improve page layouts, enforce consistent styling

userStories.title: Add dark-mode color tokens to Colors.xaml and Styles.xaml
userStories.description: As a developer, I need semantic color tokens (surface, on-surface, accent) defined as both Light and Dark AppThemeBinding resources so all views can reference them instead of hardcoded values.
acceptanceCriteria: Colors.xaml defines Light/Dark variants for: PageBackground, CardBackground, PrimaryText, SecondaryText, AccentColor, DestructiveColor, SwipeDeleteBackground
Styles.xaml defines a BaseCard style using CardBackground and a BaseButton style using AccentColor
No XAML view files are modified in this story
dotnet build PantryToPlate/ succeeds
userStories.notes: AppThemeBinding cannot be used as <Color> resource content (XamlC XC0040). Semantic colors defined inline in BaseCard/BaseButton styles via Setter.Value {AppThemeBinding ...} pattern — functionally equivalent.

userStories.title: Replace hardcoded colors in MainPage.xaml and PantryPage.xaml
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Home and Pantry pages to render correctly in dark mode without washed-out or invisible text.
acceptanceCriteria: MainPage.xaml: replace all BackgroundColor/TextColor hardcoded values with DynamicResource tokens from US-001
PantryPage.xaml: replace LightYellow/LightBlue/LightGreen hardcoded colors and SwipeView delete button color with DynamicResource tokens
PantryPage.xaml: add quantity field input validation (non-empty, numeric > 0)
dotnet build PantryToPlate/ succeeds
dotnet test PantryToPlate.Tests/ passes
userStories.notes: Colors replaced with AppThemeBinding inline or BaseCard/BaseButton styles instead of DynamicResource. Validation: added ErrorMessage/HasError properties with per-field feedback. Existing validation (NewQuantity<=0) already present.

userStories.title: Replace hardcoded colors in RecipeDetailPage.xaml, RecipeEditorPage.xaml, ShoppingListPage.xaml
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Recipe Detail, Recipe Editor, and Shopping List pages to render correctly in dark mode.
acceptanceCriteria: RecipeDetailPage.xaml: all hardcoded BackgroundColor/TextColor replaced with DynamicResource tokens
RecipeEditorPage.xaml: all hardcoded colors replaced with DynamicResource tokens
ShoppingListPage.xaml: all hardcoded colors replaced with DynamicResource tokens
dotnet build PantryToPlate/ succeeds
dotnet test PantryToPlate.Tests/ passes

userStories.title: Improve RecipeDetailPage layout and visual hierarchy
userStories.description: As a user, I want the recipe detail page to be easier to read with clear sections for ingredients and instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Ingredients and Instructions sections have distinct visual headers (bold label + separator line)
Each ingredient line shows quantity, unit, and name with consistent spacing
Instructions use a numbered list style with readable line height
Cook button is prominently placed at the bottom with AccentColor styling
dotnet build PantryToPlate/ succeeds

userStories.title: Ensure consistent button styles and spacing across all pages
userStories.description: As a user, I want a consistent look and feel throughout the app with standardized buttons, padding, and typography.
acceptanceCriteria: All primary action buttons use BaseButton style from Styles.xaml (defined in US-001)
All pages use consistent Padding='16' on their root layout
Section headers use a consistent FontSize and FontAttributes='Bold'
AppShell.xaml tab bar uses theme-aware colors
dotnet build PantryToPlate/ succeeds
dotnet test PantryToPlate.Tests/ passes
